operators.name: tril_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: supports strides; input expected contiguous but may be non-contiguous in tests

semantics: Computes lower triangular part of each matrix formed by the last two dimensions of x.
For each element at indices (..., i, j), output is x[..., i, j] if i >= j - offset, otherwise 0.
offset is the diagonal offset: positive offset keeps values on and above the main diagonal up to offset diagonals; for offset=1, keeps main diagonal and first superdiagonal.
Output has same shape, dtype, and stride as input (output tensor allocated contiguous by binding).
No broadcasting; operates elementwise on the last two dims, treating all other dimensions as batch.
Final output equals lower triangular part of x with diagonal offset 1.
